lanes.title: Prototype desktop shell and docking
lanes.goal: Prototype the native PikDraw shell, four workspaces and contextual docking; measure input/layout behavior before stack acceptance. No graphics-engine or format-support claims.

lanes.title: Prototype editable document commands
lanes.goal: Define and prototype stable object IDs, transactions, undo/redo and versioned storage with recovery evidence. Shared-contract changes require a separately scoped task.

lanes.title: Benchmark editable file interchange
lanes.goal: Evaluate PDF, PDF-compatible AI and CDR readers using synthetic or redistributable fixtures; report visual fidelity, editability, source-format export coverage and dependency licenses separately.
